__prompts__.package_name: Your Python package name, in snake case (e.g. my_package)
__prompts__.github_username: Your GitHub username, the owner of the new repo
__prompts__.license: Pick a license, as an SPDX expression for pyproject.toml, see https://choosealicense.com/ for details
__prompts__.author: Author name for pyproject.toml
__prompts__.dev_python_version: Python version for local development, in {major}.{minor} (e.g. 3.12)
__prompts__.kb_site_title: Title of the knowledge base site (sidebar, browser tab, home page H1)
__prompts__.kb_domain: Domain of the knowledge base site, a zone in your Cloudflare account; the site is https://<package-name-slug>.<kb_domain>. Keep pages.dev for no custom domain
__prompts__.kb_docs_port: Local port of `mise run view-doc`, a different one for each site (e.g. 47231)
__prompts__.github_token_field: GitHub token field. Read https://github.com/MacHu-GWU/home_secret_toml-project to learn how to set up your tokens using home_secret.toml
__prompts__.codecov_token_field: Codecov.io token field. Read https://github.com/MacHu-GWU/home_secret_toml-project to learn how to set up your tokens using home_secret.toml
__prompts__.pypi_token_field: PyPI token field. Read https://github.com/MacHu-GWU/home_secret_toml-project to learn how to set up your tokens using home_secret.toml
__prompts__.cloudflare_account_id_field: Cloudflare account ID field. Read https://github.com/MacHu-GWU/home_secret_toml-project to learn how to set up your tokens using home_secret.toml
__prompts__.cloudflare_pages_upload_token_field: Cloudflare API token field (permission: Cloudflare Pages Edit). Read https://github.com/MacHu-GWU/home_secret_toml-project to learn how to set up your tokens using home_secret.toml
